description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes API authentication v1 objects, including methods for copying and creating deep copies of structs like BoundObjectReference, SelfSubjectReview, TokenRequest, TokenReview, and UserInfo.

classes.name: BoundObjectReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to a bound object in Kubernetes.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReview
classes.description: Represents a review of the current user in Kubernetes.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReviewStatus
classes.description: Status details for SelfSubjectReview, including UserInfo.

classes.name: TokenRequest
classes.description: Represents a token request in Kubernetes authentication.

classes.name: TokenRequestSpec
classes.description: Specification for TokenRequest, including audiences, expiration, and bound object reference.

classes.name: TokenRequestStatus
classes.description: Status of a TokenRequest, including expiration timestamp and user info.

classes.name: TokenReview
classes.description: Represents a token review in Kubernetes.

classes.name: TokenReviewStatus
classes.description: Status of a TokenReview, including user info and audiences.

classes.name: UserInfo
classes.description: Contains user identity information, including groups and extra data.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the receiver.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.
